meta.name: cloudflare-one
meta.description: Design, configure, troubleshoot, or review Cloudflare One Zero Trust and SASE deployments. Use cloudflare-one-migrations for migration planning from other vendors.

copy.tagline: 设计、配置并排查零信任网络访问
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在做零信任网络改造,或需要从其他安全厂商迁移到新方案。
copy.tagline_en: Design, configure, and troubleshoot zero-trust network access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning a zero-trust or SASE deployment and need practical guidance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你规划、配置或排查 Cloudflare One 相关的访问与安全网络设置。它会先了解你的网络、身份和应用现状，再给出带检查步骤与回退方案的改动建议；有风险时会让改动先在试用小组生效。
howto.when: 当用户请求对 Cloudflare One 的 Zero Trust/SASE 部署做设计、配置或排查时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一条 Access 应用策略，只允许销售团队访问 CRM。
say.note: 它会先确认应用类型和身份源再出方案。

say.text: 我的 Gateway 过滤规则没生效，帮我排查原因。
say.note: 它会核对策略执行顺序和账户配置。

say.text: 审查现有 Tunnel 路由和 Split Tunnel 设置，给整改建议。
say.note: 它会先读取你的现有资源再提建议。

howto.what_en: Helps plan, configure, or troubleshoot Cloudflare One access and security network settings. It gathers context on network, identity, and apps, proposes changes with validation and rollback steps, and stages risky changes for a pilot group first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for help designing, configuring, or troubleshooting a Cloudflare One Zero Trust/SASE deployment.

say_en.text: Help me design an Access policy that only lets the sales team use the CRM.
say_en.note: It may ask about app type and identity first.

say_en.text: My Gateway filter rules are not applying; please troubleshoot why.
say_en.note: It will check enforcement order and account settings.

say_en.text: Review our Tunnel routes and Split Tunnel settings and suggest fixes.
say_en.note: It will inspect existing resources before recommending.
